$comment: Orochia's default avatars and banners, made by Orazaka (image-generation Studio, FLUX.2 [klein] on the Mac). Inclusive of every identity — skin tones, ages (adults), genders incl. non-binary, bodies, hair, disabilities — never stereotyped, never sexualised, no real-person likeness, no text or logo. Violet to magenta accents, premium and next-gen, readable on light and dark. Stored under public/defaults/avatars and public/defaults/banners of the product's zone.
style: Palette: deep violet to magenta accents with warm skin-tone variety. Clean premium composition, soft studio light, no text, no lettering, no logos, fully clothed, wholesome.
